description: This is a shell script used for managing RDM applications, including downloading, verifying, uninstalling old packages, and sending notifications about the application download statuses in a device management context.

methods.name: checkAppDownload
methods.description: Verifies if the application's download data and manifest exist in the designated directory.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends an application download status notification via a system event sender binary.

methods.name: updatePkgStatus
methods.description: Updates the package status and broadcasts it.

methods.name: uninstallPackages
methods.description: Removes old packages that are no longer listed in the current manifest.
